source.task_description: Titanic passenger survival. pclass: 1=first, 2=second, 3=third class. age_years is age; fare_gbp is fare in British pounds; sibsp counts siblings/spouses and parch counts parents/children aboard. Missing=NA.

tabular.duplicate_policy: Retain all natural duplicates and conflicting-label groups in one split; no exact-feature overlap across splits
tabular.group_definition: SHA256 of normalized serialized features, excluding target and row ID
tabular.leakage_limitations: Exact feature grouping does not prevent related-family similarity or pretraining memorization of these public datasets. Wine cultivar IDs are arbitrary; zero-shot interpretation is limited.

serialization.number_format: .12g (12 significant decimal digits; no data-dependent rounding)
serialization.prefix: fixed task description followed by newline

tabular.split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed): fold0=test; fold1=validation; remaining folds=train
tabular.task_description: Titanic passenger survival. pclass: 1=first, 2=second, 3=third class. age_years is age; fare_gbp is fare in British pounds; sibsp counts siblings/spouses and parch counts parents/children aboard. Missing=NA.
tabular.test_subset_policy: Frozen core deterministic proportional stratified subset; excluded rows remain held out and are never reassigned

features.numeric_missing: training median; all-missing training column becomes zero

training.latency_measurement: amortized batch; not individual request latency
